1: And I ⌞looked up⌟ and I saw, and look, there were four horns!
2: And I said to the angel who was talking with me, “What are these?” And he said to me, “These are the horns that have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.”
3: Then Yahweh showed me four skilled craftsmen,
4: and I asked, “What are these coming to do?” And he answered, saying, “These are the horns that scattered Judah, ⌞so that no man⌟ lifted up his head; but these have come to frighten them, to strike down the horns of the nations that lifted a horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.”
5: And I ⌞looked up⌟ and I saw, and look, a man, and in his hand was a measuring rope!
6: And I asked, “Where are you going?” And he answered me, “To measure Jerusalem to see what is its width and what is its length.”
7: And look, the angel who was talking to me was coming forward, and another angel was coming forward to meet him.
8: And he said to him, “Run, say to that young man, ‘Jerusalem shall be inhabited ⌞like villages without walls⌟ because of the multitude of people and animals in its midst.
9: And I will be for it a wall of fire all around,’ ⌞declares⌟ Yahweh, ‘and I will be the glory in its midst.’”
10: “Woe! Woe! Flee from the land of the north,” ⌞declares⌟ Yahweh, “for I have scattered you like the four winds of the heavens,” ⌞declares⌟ Yahweh.
11: “Woe, Zion! Escape, you inhabitants of the daughter of Babylon!”
12: For thus said Yahweh of hosts, after glory he sent me against the nations plundering you: Truly, the one touching you is touching the apple of his eye.
13: “Yes, look! I am going to wave my hand against them, and they will become plunder for their servants, and you will know that Yahweh of hosts has sent me.
14: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion, for look, I am coming and I will dwell in your midst,” ⌞declares⌟ Yahweh.
15: “Many nations will join themselves to Yahweh on that day, and they will be my people, and I will dwell in your midst. And you will know that Yahweh of hosts has sent me to you.
16: And Yahweh will inherit Judah as his portion ⌞in the holy land⌟, and he will again choose Jerusalem.
17: Be silent, ⌞all people⌟, before Yahweh, for he is roused from ⌞his holy dwelling⌟.”
